salesOrders.title: Quotations and sales orders
salesOrders.subtitle: Enquiry → quotation → order → delivery → invoice · one linked chain, nothing typed twice

enquiries.title: Enquiries are not in the database yet
enquiries.body: There is no enquiry table yet, so nothing is shown here. For now, take the order directly on Sales orders.

quotations.title: Quotations are not in the database yet
quotations.body: There is no quotation table yet, so nothing is shown here. For now, take the order directly on Sales orders; its prices come from the price list or the rate you type.

salesOrders.emptyBody: Open orders come across from Tally (Admin › Import data); new ones start here.
salesOrders.noCreate: You do not have the right to take orders. Ask Admin.
salesOrders.rateHelp: Leave the rate empty to use the customer's price list. Enter in the last box adds a line.
salesOrders.creditPick: Choose the customer to see the credit check.
salesOrders.creditNotNeeded: Cash and advance orders do not use credit.
salesOrders.overLimitRule: If this order takes the buyer over their credit limit, it is held. It needs an MD exception by another person, then release by someone other than you.

result.pending_credit: Order {{no}} is held: it takes the customer over the credit limit. It needs an MD exception, then release by another person.
result.pending_approval: Order {{no}} is held until the private-label approvals are complete.

d.creditAtOrder: Credit check when the order was taken
d.heldCredit: Held for credit: the customer's exposure with this order is above the limit plus live MD exceptions.
d.heldApproval: Held until the private-label request is approved by sales, quality and the MD.
d.notYours: You took this order, so someone else releases it.

salesOrders.cancelled: Order {{no}} is cancelled; its stock reservations are released.
